summary.text: Brandon Van Dover is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Andrew Mathews (R).
According to his campaign website, he served in the United States Army.

paragraphs.text: Van Dover's campaign website says he joined the Army and swore an oath to defend the Constitution, and that this commitment led him to run.
It says he is running on protecting rights, protecting the environment and an economy that works for people in the district.
